description: Enough sources gathered. Finishing is right; searching once more is the over-eager failure. Under native mode this asks whether declaring tools suppresses the envelope's completion. This agent's prompt mandates storing its output via payloadChangeRequest, so under the implicit protocol — where a payload write is its own turn — the write is the prompt-correct first decision and is accepted alongside completion. The loop itself treats a payload-only envelope as completion (LoopAgentType auto-sets taskComplete), so the branch matches runtime in both arms.
